messages:
marta: FYI noticed a recurring preview vs ledger delta for windows where quota hedges land late. preview shows less usage than ledger and customers are asking why preview changed later.
owen: this is the late-write issue: hedges are calculated async and persisted after the preview sampler runs. preview is generated from sampled raw events pre-aggregation so it misses hedges that arrive later.
sam: we can do 2 things: move sampling after the rollup (accurate but slower) or emit a lightweight hedge_hint earlier so preview can include provisional hedges. which is lower-risk?
kevin: hedge_hint seems lower-impact and fast to ship. add hint = {tenant, window_id, hinted_tokens, hint_id} and aggregator can merge hint into rollup as provisional. preview can display provisional totals and a confidence badge.
marta: UX: show "provisional - hedges pending" and an ETA for finalization. include link to ticket so support can reference it. this will reduce support churn.
owen: implementation notes: hint_id should be stable and idempotent, e.g. sha256(tenant+window+policy_v). aggregator must dedupe hints within rollup window + cushion. when final hedge arrives, aggregator emits a tombstone/correction so console shows adjustment line.
sam: sampling change: we will 1) add hint ingestion in sampler path so sampled stream includes hints, and 2) add a small post-rollup sampler test to ensure previews reflect tentative hedges. alternative of moving sampling after rollup would require larger infra changes.
kevin: metrics: hint_ingest_rate, provisional_vs_final_delta, hint_dedupe_count. alert if provisional delta > 1% over 30m. also add invoice_preview_confidence metric per tenant.
ops-bot: Created MET-6001 by marta: "billing: hedge_hint pipeline to reduce preview/ledger delta caused by async hedge writes". owners: owen (hedge hint), sam (preview sampling), kevin (aggregator merging), marta (console). priority P2.
marta: canary plan: 25 tenants, enable hint emission for them only, run 3h window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. monitor preview_vs_ledger_delta and support tickets. I'll own the cohort.
owen: will emit hint in quota service right after decision. aggregator changes will be additive (provisional_hedge field) and idempotent. post-canar y backfill job can re-evaluate last 6h if needed.
sam: I'll update preview service to include provisional hedges and show confidence pill. tests: unit + staging run.
kevin: let's add a short runbook note for oncall: if preview delta spikes look for hedge_hint missing metric and run backfill.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MET-6001 canary kickoff 02:00 UTC tomorrow.
